params.prompt:
Single continuous shot, locked-off tripod camera: no camera movement, no zoom, no cuts.

Lume, the furry mascot seated at the podcast table, whispers one Hebrew sentence to his co-host off-screen to the right, nervously. His speech is exactly the reference audio and his lips are synced to it: he starts at 0.5 seconds and finishes at 1.7 seconds, saying: "תגיד להם שאני לא כאן".

Performance: panicked and sneaky. Both paws stay flat on the table the whole time and are never raised. He leans toward the co-host, hunches his shoulders and whispers the line out of the side of his mouth with worried eyebrows and darting eyes. Right after the last word he closes his mouth and sinks straight down in his chair behind the table, slowly, his paws sliding off the table edge, until only his eyes, ears and hair tuft are still showing above the tabletop at the end of the shot.

He stays exactly on-model as in the first frame: same fur, ears, eyes, eyebrows, nose, whiskers, hair tuft and tail. Only his two small upper front teeth ever show, never lower teeth. His paws are plain fur with no paw pads. The microphone, chair, table, shelves, plants and lighting stay completely still and unchanged.

Audio: only his voice from the reference audio. No music, no sound effects, no other voices.
